verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official terminal CLI, `wmill` [windmill-docs-9, windmill-probe-5], and supports CLI deployments from a Git repository [windmill-docs-4] plus Git sync that pushes commits and auto-deploys new ones [windmill-docs-11]. Scripts and flows can also be run without the UI via webhooks, version-pinned flow webhooks, many event triggers and CRON schedules [windmill-docs-15, windmill-docs-16, windmill-docs-18], on self-hosted Docker or Kubernetes deployments [windmill-docs-10]. Missing for 10: an explicit CI pipeline guide (e.g., GitHub Actions or pre-merge validation of branch versions), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes of candidate paths on the docs domain returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of headless or CI use.
